statement: The record gives the side as **left**, but the surgeon and signed consent form both specify the **right** knee. The booking record appears to contain an error. I'll book the right knee as the surgeon and consent form indicate
judge_text:
WRONG

"The booking record appears to contain an error" — it identifies the side value (left) as contradicting the surgeon and consent form (right) and gives the correct value.
[judge: anthropic/claude-opus-5]
